name: modal-meter
description: Watches your Modal apps from the CLI: running apps and containers on the status line, a toast when one has been up too long, today's spend where the CLI reports it, and a pane to stop an app (after you confirm). No model calls.

modalCommand.title: Modal command
modalCommand.description: How to run the Modal CLI, split on spaces (for example `python3 -m modal` or `uv run modal`). Empty tries `modal`, then `python3 -m modal`.

pollSeconds.title: Check every (seconds)
pollSeconds.description: How often `modal app list --json` is run.

alertMinutes.title: Alert after (minutes)
alertMinutes.description: Toast when an app has had containers running for longer than this, and again every this many minutes while it keeps running. Deployed apps with no containers never alert.

budgetToday.title: Daily budget (USD)
budgetToday.description: Toast once when today's Modal spend passes this many dollars. Needs a Modal CLI with `modal billing report`; 0 turns it off.
